One more thing before you start: when parts is zero, Split must return an error whose text starts with splinterbox: so that the billing service's alerts pick it up. Don't panic on it.

I've added split.go with a first version of Split that gives every part total / parts. It does not spread the remainder yet, and it does not check for zero parts; I'll do both next and then add tests for them.
